title: (2nd LD) Seoul stocks rebound over 2 pct on bargain hunting
caption:
South Korea’s main index jumped more than 2% after a sharp fall, driven by investors snapping up semiconductor shares. Institutional buying outweighed foreign selling, showing confidence in chip earnings despite AI‑spending worries.
